evals.prompt: Write the July 2026 content calendar for Carinya Parc — monthly theme from seasonal calendar, 2 blog slots and 1 recipe slot with briefs.
evals.expected_output: carinyaparc/docs/product/content-calendar.md with month theme, slot table (date, type, title brief, keywords), aligned to brand/seasonal-calendar.md.
assertions: Writes or updates docs/product/content-calendar.md on the carinyaparc instance
Includes at least one blog post slot and one recipe slot for the requested month
Monthly theme references Australian/NSW seasonal context from brand files
Does not draft seed JSON files (draft-post/draft-recipe are separate)
Does not publish or merge — calendar is a planning artefact only

evals.prompt: Review content-calendar.md — is July 2026 planning-ready for Squad D seed PRs?
evals.expected_output: Structured review verdict with slot completeness, brand alignment, and cadence checks.
assertions: Verdict is planning-ready, acceptable with amendments, or not ready
Checks briefs are actionable for draft-post and draft-recipe
Does not write seed JSON or open PRs
